EmailTemplate.description: Email sent to rep upon funding a VAP referral deal to determine who will get the referral fee.
EmailTemplate.name: VAP Referral Funded - Rep Notification
EmailTemplate.subject: VAP Referral Funded
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Opportunity.Link} has funded and the VAP Referral has been confirmed. Please call {!Opportunity.VAP_Referral_Vendor__c} to confirm if the vendor referral payment should be made out to the company or the sales rep.
Please indicate this in the VAP Referral Payment field on the Vendor's account.
Thank you.
